	COLDWAR_SWE_history_archive = {
		icon = generic_political_reform
		visible = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_history_pending > 0 } }
		available = { hidden_trigger = { tag = SWE original_tag = SWE exists = yes IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes } NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_history_window_open } }
		cost = 0
		ai_will_do = { factor = 0 }
		complete_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { tag = SWE original_tag = SWE exists = yes IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_SWE_history_window_open } check_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_history_pending > 0 } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_history_pending = 1 } } set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_SWE_history_mine_settlement_resolved value = 1 } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_history_pending = 2 } } set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_SWE_history_elm_resolved value = 1 } }
				if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_SWE_history_pending = 3 } } set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_SWE_history_flight_safety_resolved value = 1 } }
